title: TenantEvent
description: Structured audit record emitted for every tenant-aware operation and published to AuditForge over an authenticated channel (core/spec.md, Security Requirements). This schema is the cross-language contract; all implementations MUST serialize to it.

eventId.description: Unique event identifier (UUID recommended). Idempotency key for AuditForge.

eventType.description: What happened, in dotted namespace form, e.g. 'tenant.resolved', 'db.access', 'tenant.switch.rejected'.

tenantId.description: Tenant the event belongs to. Matches TenantContext.tenantId.

timestamp.description: Event time in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC.

outcome.description: Result of the operation being audited.

traceId.description: W3C trace-id correlating this event with the originating request.

actor.description: Principal that triggered the operation (user id, service account, system).

resource.description: Target of the operation, e.g. a schema name, table, topic, or endpoint.

metadata.description: Additional structured context for the event.

signature.description: Optional detached signature over the event body when events are signed rather than sent over an authenticated channel.
